species.real: Reindeer in Lapland eat fly agaric and seem to enjoy it, and one popular but much disputed theory links its red and white cap to Father Christmas's suit.
species.name: Flyling

dex.text: Turns up in a ring under the birches overnight and acts as if it has always been there. Do not lick it, whatever it tells you.
dex.fact: Fly agaric gets its name from the old trick of breaking it into a saucer of milk to attract and kill flies.

species.real: Fly agaric is poisonous but rarely kills; the deadly one is its plain-looking cousin the death cap, which looks nothing like a fairy tale and causes most fatal mushroom poisonings.
species.name: Amanitar

dex.text: Looks exactly like the toadstool in every fairy tale book, and knows it. Gnomes have been seen queueing to sit on it.
dex.fact: Fly agaric lives in partnership with the roots of birch and pine, trading water and minerals for sugar; this is called mycorrhiza.
